template.p: This module is designed for companies providing solar equipment and installation services. Whether managing residential customers placing orders from 1 kW to 10 kW or commercial clients going up to 100 kW, Odoo coordinates the deployment of solar panels, inverters, and batteries based on kW capacity.

By linking your customer leads directly with employee shift planning, project tracking, inventory, and billing, Odoo keeps your solar operations organized while offering a smooth experience to your clients.
You can access every installed App in your Odoo database on your main dashboard.

li.p: The CRM App captures leads and tracks them through the sales funnel, managing site visits and technical feasibility checks.
The Sales App creates professional, detailed proposals that include technical specifications for panels, inverters, and labor costs.
The Project App manages installation projects with clear stages, tracking specific tasks and deadlines.
The Inventory App keeps track of high-value stock like solar modules and batteries, ensuring you have the right components for every job.
The Website App showcases your successful installations and attracts new eco-conscious clients with a professional online presence.
The Sign App securely collects digital signatures for contracts, interconnection agreements, and financing documents.
The Planning App organizes and allocates worker shifts, schedules physical site visits, and manages deployment resources.
The Helpdesk App manages solar system support issues, equipment returns, and repair tickets.

template.p: Capture incoming digital interest and smoothly transition it into a scheduled operational deployment.

li.p: Lead Creation: A potential customer fills out the "Contact Us" form on your website. Odoo instantly creates a corresponding opportunity card inside the CRM app.

CRM Stages & Follow-up: A salesperson is assigned and the opportunity is moved to the Qualified stage. The salesperson manages follow-ups through activities like calls and meetings. If the customer agrees to move forward, a technical site survey is scheduled, and the opportunity shifts to the next stage.
Quotation for Installation: The final technical quotation for the installation is generated and sent to the customer. Once approved, 100% advance payment is received.
Planning Shift for Installation: Once the Sales Order is confirmed, a Planning Shift is created for the solar system installation.

Worksheet Submission: Upon completing the physical build, assignees fill out the installation worksheet on-site. Technicians capture real-time images of the solar setup and log the customer’s confirmation for the worksheet.

div.class: o_editor_banner user-select-none lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-info pb-0 pt-3 o-contenteditable-false

div.p: Custom Worksheet Templates: The installation worksheet utilizes specialized fields (like Start Date, End Date, and Plan) configured directly through your Planning Worksheet Templates.

li.p: Opportunities can also be launched manually by your sales team directly inside the CRM app when handling phone inquiries or direct B2B outreach. Once the manual card is active, the workflow follows the exact same path from site survey to installation as the website form flow.

template.p: Manage component servicing, hardware debugging, and active warranty verification when clients need equipment maintenance.
template.pre:
[Helpdesk Ticket Logged] ➔ [Draft Repair Created & Warranty Checked] ➔ [Inventory Return Inspected]
│
[Ticket Closed via Customer Confirmation] ◀ [Repair Executed & Status Updated] ◀───┘

li.p: Helpdesk Ticket: Customers submit a support request via email, a website "Submit a Ticket" form. This automatically generates a support ticket in the Helpdesk app.
Draft Repair Creation: The support agent opens the ticket, builds a matching Repair Order in draft mode, and populates customer fields, the equipment target, and the original Warranty End Date.
Warranty Verification: Odoo pulls the item's warranty expiration date directly from its original inventory delivery record.

Inventory Inspection: Inventory users validate the incoming returned physical hardware. If the system logs show the equipment is outside its active coverage window, an automated invoice is raised for the replacement parts and technical labor charges.
Repair Execution: The assigned technician confirms the repair, performs the work, and uses the Chatter feature to notify the helpdesk user when finished.
Fulfillment & Closure: The helpdesk user contacts the customer to coordinate whether they will pick up the equipment or require it shipped back to their address:
In case of pickup: The ticket is closed as resolved after the customer inspects and approves the equipment at the site.
In case of delivery: The agent communicates with the client following delivery, confirms the system is fully functional, and closes the ticket.

template.p: Maximize accuracy, eliminate double data entry, and keep your field operations accountable with integrated automation features:

li.p: Enforce Field Accountability: Implement a mandatory geo-location-based Check-In/Check-Out tracking mechanism. Site surveys and installation worksheets are linked directly to these coordinates, allowing management to instantly verify physical field presence.

Streamline Data Flow: Enable automated data traceability across your entire funnel. Information flows instantly from CRM Opportunity ➔ Planning App ➔ Site Survey/Worksheet ➔ Sales Quotation/Order ➔ Project Creation, eliminating manual errors and duplicate data entry.

Stock Variant Management: Sales teams can offer multiple branded hardware options within a single quotation. This gives your logistics operations the flexibility to deliver available warehouse stock variants without needing to revise or re-approve confirmed sales documents.

Automate Quantities & Invoicing: Utilize the "Set Quantity" feature in Sales Orders to quickly update standard product benchmarks, while ensuring that all downstream inventory deliveries and billing lines automatically sync based on actual delivered items.
